# fastf 3.10.0 — phases in the app, and Motion that turns back on

Nothing about an existing project changes. Every `PROJECT_INFO.md`,
`config.toml` and template works untouched, and no command, flag or file format
was removed.

## Add a phase

A todo list could be grouped into phases (`### Main Edit` over its tasks), and
the detail pane showed them, but only `fastf todo add --phase` could start one.
The app can now.

- **`P`**, Enter on the pane's new **add a phase** row, or **Add a phase** in
  the palette or the action menu opens a line where the heading will go: at the
  end of the list, or above an `### Other` phase when the list has one.
- Type the name and press Enter. The heading is drawn and the todo line opens
  under it, and from there it works like `+`: Enter writes a todo and opens the
  next line, a pasted checklist becomes one todo per line, and an empty Enter or
  Esc is done.
- The phase is written with its first todo. Leave without typing one and
  nothing is written, and the status line says so. A name the list already has,
  in any case, adds to that phase.
- With the pane switched off, `P` asks for the name, then the first todo.

A name typed with its markdown (`## Grade:`) is written as the name it reads
back as, `### Grade`, from the app and from `fastf todo add --phase` alike.

## Fixes

- **Motion could not be turned back on.** On the settings screen, the Motion row
  wrote `off` on every press, so once it was off it stayed off until
  `config.toml` was edited by hand. It switches both ways now.
